tagline: Empowering communities through entrepreneurial education and skills development across NSW
hero_kpi_rationale: SSE delivered programs to 2,446 participants and issued 534 industry-recognized badges in 2022, demonstrating direct and measurable impact in entrepreneurial skills development and accessible education.

kpis.name: Program Participants
kpis.explanation: Total number of participants engaged in SSE programs annually
kpis.description: 2022 annual report states SSE delivered programs to 2,446 participants from secondary schools, tertiary institutions, businesses and community groups across NSW

kpis.name: Industry Badges Issued
kpis.explanation: Number of industry-recognised credentials and badges awarded annually
kpis.description: 2022 annual report documents issuance of 534 industry-recognised badges demonstrating verifiable skills capability and credentials

kpis.name: Program Delivery Model
kpis.explanation: Hybrid model combining in-person and online delivery across NSW
kpis.description: 2022 marked return to hybrid delivery model with co-design, co-innovation and co-delivery both in-person and online across regional NSW

kpis.name: Partnership Scope
kpis.explanation: Breadth of partnerships spanning secondary schools, universities, businesses, government and community groups
kpis.description: SSE partnerships span diverse sectors including secondary schools, tertiary institutions, businesses of all sizes, councils, government, and First Nations communities across NSW and beyond

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from yfinance.income_stmt over the last 4 years. Metric tracked annually, historical values maintained over the past 4 years.
kpis.signal: Revenue of €10.13 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €30.36 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €10.6 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of €1.09 Bn in the latest year

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence in SSE's 2022 annual report. Programs focus on entrepreneurial education, skills development, and innovation capability building through human-centered learning pathways.
evidence: No references to AI, machine learning, or related technologies in annual report content
Programs focus on entrepreneurship fundamentals, digital skills, and workplace innovation
Emphasis on human skills: creativity, critical thinking, problem-solving, adaptability
